data.title: NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX Now in Full Production With World-Class Speed for Agentic AI
data.description: NVIDIA today announced that NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX, the interactive AI inference accelerator, is now in full production. An extension of the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform, Groq 3 LPX delivers a major boost in AI inference by enabling ultrafast token generation for highly responsive agentic systems.
